verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a choice of data storage location (US or EU) for its hosted service. It also lets you run all of Sentry on your own server, which gives full control over where data lives, and community users confirm running self-hosted instances in production. missing for 10: details on how the region is selected and whether it can be changed after setup, any regions beyond US/EU, independent corroboration of the hosted region choice (the region citation is only a heading).
